ann-arbor/coffee: Hyperion Coffee Co for the best beans in town, The Boro Cafe & Bakery for the coffee (skip the $10 crookie), and Cahoots Cafe, which brews Hyperion beans even better than Hyperion does.
ann-arbor/restaurants: Frita Batidos Ann Arbor is my favorite, Miny's Mexican Restaurant is easily the best Mexican in town (get the churros and the shrimp taco), and The Jefferson Market has maybe the best scrambled eggs I've ever had.
ann-arbor/dessert: La Dolce Vita Ann Arbor for gelato, then Milk & Froth Ice Cream and Blank Slate Creamery.
metro-detroit/novi-restaurants: Hyderabad house Indian Restaurant & Bakery is my top pick, Phở Lucky for pho and Mala Land for the spice. At Shiro Restaurant, stick to the sushi rolls.
new-york/east-village-restaurants: Adda for the paneer curry and a surprisingly great dessert, Soothr and Cello's Pizzeria right behind it, and Farook Halal Food for $8 chicken over rice.
new-york/restaurants: Angel is my 10: get the chicken dum biryani and the egg pav. Adda has the better curry and a surprisingly great dessert, and Soothr and Tamarind Tribeca are right behind.
new-york/coffee: Caffe Paradiso for super smooth coffee on tap (the line can run an hour), Toby's Estate Coffee for a latte with vanilla bean-infused milk, and 787 Coffee. Verse has the best matcha I've had, and HEYTEA（Herald Square） is my boba pick for the mango.
new-york/east-village-coffee: Square Coffee is my top pick, then Hidden Grounds Chai & Coffee House - Manhattan, a great spot near the 6 train. At 787 Coffee, pay the extra $3 for the special beans.
new-york/long-island-city-restaurants: Blue Pad Thai 1992, a Thai food truck with great fried rice and generous meat portions, is my top pick. Then Darjeeling Kitchen & Café for momos and Gulp for the fries.
south-bay/restaurants: Mylapore South Indian Vegetarian for insane value (a meal plus a masala dosa for $20), Tacos Mi Reynita for the crunchwrap, and Samuthr Thai Restaurant for big portions. Bloom Bagels and Mazala Pizza San Jose are up there too.
south-bay/coffee: Dr.ink for great coffee, a great vibe and easy parking, Cowboy Coffee for sitting outside with friends, and PRIMERO CAFECITO, a coffee truck in someone's yard that does dessert coffee.
south-bay/san-jose-coffee: Dr.ink is my top pick, PRIMERO CAFECITO is a coffee truck in someone's yard worth finding, and Chromatic Coffee Co. is incredibly smooth. At Academic Coffee, get the cold brew.
metro-detroit/coffee: Jabal Coffee House is my top pick. Apothecary Espresso and Coffee is amazing for the price (get the salted caramel latte, skip the matcha), then Tous Les Jours Novi.
san-francisco/restaurants: La Taqueria for the best burrito I've ever had, then Mymy and Outta Sight Pizza II. Khao Tiew is the most well-rounded Thai spot; get the pad see ew and save room for dessert.
